steps.name: Spokesman McKee
steps.text: A moment please, Mr. Malkiewicz.

steps.name: Spokesman Malkiewicz
steps.text: Ah, Mr. McKee. Do... do you need me for something?

steps.name: Spokesman McKee
steps.text: It's good to see you again. Have you gotten the letter from the Chamber?

steps.name: Spokesman McKee
steps.text: The only spokesmen on competition duty for the duration of the Major will be us two... an arduous task, but a gallery of eyes will be trained on us.

steps.name: Spokesman McKee
steps.text: If you want to continue your ascent up the ladder after you drop the 'spokesman' title, this is your greatest chance.

steps.name: Spokesman Malkiewicz
steps.text: Haha... even if you're joking, I'm not really into the attention. I'd rather go off and handle arena event planning and stuff...

steps.name: Spokesman McKee
steps.text: Is that your particular expertise?

steps.name: Spokesman Malkiewicz
steps.text: It's not exactly expertise or inability or whatever, I'm just...

steps.name: Spokesman McKee
steps.text: You're being modest again. You've adapted much faster than any of the more senior personnel.

steps.name: Spokesman McKee
steps.text: —But I have something else I needed to tell you first. I need you to know in advance.

steps.name: Spokesman McKee
steps.text: Let's find a lounge to talk in?

steps.name: Spokesman Malkiewicz
steps.text: Yes, you're the boss...

steps.name: Spokesman Malkiewicz
steps.text: What is it that needs such secrecy??

steps.name: Spokesman McKee
steps.text: I... shouldn't actually be telling you this, but Mr. Czarny left quite hastily.

steps.name: Spokesman McKee
steps.text: On each Major occasion, Kawalerielki picks three of the cities with the most rapidly developing economies to merge into the Grand Knight Territory you see now.

steps.name: Spokesman McKee
steps.text: Within the few months following each Major, non-Grand Knight Territory cities aside, the nomadic cities return within their own one-month span to their original routes, following the route engineers' plans.

steps.name: Spokesman McKee
steps.text: Each merging of the four cities is glorious. Marvelous flows of people, seamless trade relations, as well as the chance... to deal with a few problems.

steps.name: Spokesman McKee
steps.text: To be honest, if it weren't for how excessively enormous the Kawalerielki Alliance is in scale, how unable it is to effectively move and avoid Catastrophes, and how difficult it is to handle supply distribution and mining...

steps.name: Spokesman McKee
steps.text: I'd hope to never see the disbanding of the Kawalerielki Alliance.

steps.name: Spokesman McKee
steps.text: But what I'm going to tell you today is about... mm... an unspoken rule.

steps.name: Spokesman Malkiewicz
steps.text: Regarding...?

steps.name: Spokesman McKee
steps.text: ...The Infected.

steps.name: Spokesman McKee
steps.text: This year, Mieszko Industrial Group has provided the Grand Knight Territory seven nomadic platforms, to rival other countries' whole cities in scale... of course, this is how it appears on the surface.

steps.name: Spokesman Malkiewicz
steps.text: I heard about this from my colleagues.

steps.name: Spokesman McKee
steps.text: The main thing we should focus on right now is Area 0. It shows up nowhere on the legal listing Mieszko Industries has given.

steps.name: Spokesman McKee
steps.text: It is a unique plate—a small-scale nomadic platform, currently linked at the southwest corner, outside Plate #17.

steps.name: Spokesman Malkiewicz
steps.text: That's where...

steps.name: Spokesman McKee
steps.text: Yes. It's right next to the Infected shelter and treatment center.

steps.name: Spokesman McKee
steps.text: Do pardon me, Mr. Malkiewicz, but every word we're about to exchange must be on video record.

steps.name: Spokesman McKee
steps.text: This is by regulation. No spokesperson is permitted to act in any way which would betray the General Chamber.

steps.name: Spokesman Malkiewicz
steps.text: ...I understand.

steps.name: Spokesman McKee
steps.text: You look pained. I understand. When I first heard of it, I felt much the same as you.

steps.name: Spokesman Malkiewicz
steps.text: It's just, this is too cruel...

steps.name: Spokesman McKee
steps.text: You are now an executor of the Board of Directors, a spokesman of the General Chamber of Commerce, Malkiewicz, my good man.

steps.name: Spokesman McKee
steps.text: That's a reminder, nothing more. Of course it's not an admonishment or a threat—haha, Mr. Czarny always did carry that air, didn't he?

steps.name: Spokesman McKee
steps.text: Get a grasp of it all. Know what he's told you. Do as he said.

steps.name: Spokesman McKee
steps.text: I don't mean it that way, Malkiewicz. We have to help each other.

steps.name: Spokesman McKee
steps.text: You need to chew thoroughly over what I've told you. I'm off to check on a few Knightclubs.

steps.name: Spokesman McKee
steps.text: Be seeing you.

steps.name: Zofia
steps.text: ...Młynar?

steps.name: Zofia
steps.text: Are you there? M—

steps.name: Margaret
steps.text: Aunt Zofia?

steps.name: Zofia
steps.text: Oh... Margaret. Why are you still at home?

steps.name: Zofia
steps.text: Didn't Maria say you were going to the Knights Association? That girl...

steps.name: Margaret
steps.text: It's rote procedure. It won't take much effort.

steps.name: Zofia
steps.text: Heheh. You really have changed.

steps.name: Zofia
steps.text: Is it thanks to that 'Rhodes Island' place? You never were any good with the paperwork side of things before.

steps.name: Zofia
steps.text: Do you still remember when you'd just applied to become a knight? Independent knight Margaret Nearl, always getting her documents and processes mixed up...

steps.name: Margaret
steps.text: Yes. I'm lucky I had you then, Auntie.

steps.name: Zofia
steps.text: *Sigh*... I understand it with Maria at least, but aren't you the same age as me?

steps.name: Zofia
steps.text: I spent so much energy getting you to call me by name. We're apart a few years and now that's undone?

steps.name: Zofia
steps.text: We can't have gotten strange from each other, can we? Hm?

steps.name: Margaret
steps.text: Heheh, don't worry, Zofia. It's just been a long while since I've talked with family like this, face to face.

steps.name: Margaret
steps.text: Were you here looking for Uncle?

steps.name: Zofia
steps.text: Yes. Is he still at work?

steps.name: Margaret
steps.text: Still not home anyway.

steps.name: Zofia
steps.text: You know, Młynar...

steps.name: Margaret
steps.text: ...I know.

steps.name: Margaret
steps.text: I'll be civil with him, and I won't blame him either.

steps.name: Margaret
steps.text: So don't worry.

steps.name: Maria
steps.text: Oh... the match's about to start.

steps.name: Old Knight
steps.text: Same as it ever was. Turnout's ridiculous.

steps.name: Old Knight
steps.text: That Blade Helmet Knightclub sap there, didn't he show up last year too?

steps.name: Old Craftsman
steps.text: Here, forget him, even their Left-hand Knight fell to Maria. What's the Blade Helmet Knightclub got?

steps.name: Maria
steps.text: Ugh... it was just luck, all luck. It's always embarrassing when they blow things out of proportion.

steps.name: Bald Marcin
steps.text: Oh. Seems like 'Brassrust' Olmer Ingra's in this match tonight too...

steps.name: Old Knight
steps.text: Ha, well-acquainted, aren't you, Maria—

steps.name: Old Craftsman
steps.text: —Learn to shut your mouth.

steps.name: Maria
steps.text: It's alright, Master Kowal.

steps.name: Maria
steps.text: I've already given up on becoming a competition knight. It just doesn't suit me.

steps.name: Old Knight
steps.text: That's what I'm saying! You've got a wide world of options open to you—no need to choose this or that! That's a bit of old-timer advice there!

steps.name: Old Knight
steps.text: Besides, you've made a mighty fine showing already! Cheers to you!

steps.name: Old Craftsman
steps.text: Speaking of, we still haven't done final testing on Margaret's armor, have we?

steps.name: Old Craftsman
steps.text: Her last suit had some decent work on it, but it still doesn't fit a Kuranta as big and brave as Margaret.

steps.name: Maria
steps.text: Ah... I already started on adjustments myself. I'll need a bit more time.

steps.name: Maria
steps.text: And there's her weapon...

steps.name: Bald Marcin
steps.text: When Margaret was new to the knight competitions, she used a warhammer. After that, she switched to a knight's longsword. Halos shone at her blade's edge.

steps.name: Bald Marcin
steps.text: Now—she's on a swordspear.

steps.name: Old Craftsman
steps.text: Hah! It's a Minoan beauty forged of D32 Steel. The ultimate in Originium Arts conductivity!

steps.name: Old Craftsman
steps.text: Really takes me back. She came knocking, asking if I could change her sword out for an easier one to handle—the very first time Old Nearl's granddaughter ever asked a word of me—

steps.name: Old Knight
steps.text: Enough nostalgia, Kowal, the Radiant Knight's down in the arena next week. Are you people even helping her?!

steps.name: Old Craftsman
steps.text: Repeat that? You think I'm anything like you? Nothing but drink and idle hands all day?

steps.name: Bald Marcin
steps.text: (Brassrust Knight's lined up for... capture the flag? Why's Bloodboil Knightclub squandered an elite knight on such a high-risk low-reward format...)

steps.name: Bald Marcin
steps.text: (His opponent is... Oh, they're all small-time Knightclubs...)

steps.name: Bald Marcin
steps.text: (...Hold on, there's an Infected knight in this...)
The main Major matches. Mm-hm.
When you became an Infected, did you ever picture a day like this?
Ever picture being in this arena, winning yourself more wealth than nine lives could make?

steps.name: An Infected Knight
steps.text: I know... I know.

steps.name: An Infected Knight
steps.text: It's been my honor to join Pinus Sylvestris Knightclub, Wild Mane.
Hah, just call me by my name.

steps.name: An Infected Knight
steps.text: Fine! Once I get that prize money, I'll take you for drinks, Iwona.

steps.name: Iwona
steps.text: Deal! No one ever drinks with me except Ashlock. Here I was getting bored out of my skull—

steps.name: Iwona
steps.text: —Do you still remember the rules of capture the flag?

steps.name: An Infected Knight
steps.text: I do. Stay inside the score lines and avoid direct clashes—

steps.name: Iwona
steps.text: Hey, that's all the boilerplate Sona teaches you—if you ask me, you smash those noble knights' armor to pieces, you're the champion.

steps.name: Iwona
steps.text: Anyone makes for your points, you sort them out. Easy as easy comes, yeah?

steps.name: An Infected Knight
steps.text: Ha, hahaha... if I can do it, yeah.

steps.name: Iwona
steps.text: Have a little confidence. You don't sound off proper, they won't give you any respect.

steps.name: Iwona
steps.text: If you want others looking up at you, it's simple as dumping them on the ground, right?

steps.name: Iwona
steps.text: But signs say someone's out for you, hah. Didn't Ashlock beat him bad enough?

steps.name: An Infected Knight
steps.text: Olmer Ingra... is he only here to knock Infected heads?

steps.name: An Infected Knight
steps.text: He sure has a narrow mind.

steps.name: Iwona
steps.text: Kid nobles, pteh.

steps.name: Iwona
steps.text: Looks like the Ashlock thing hurt his self-esteem some. Puffed up bags of hot air don't even deserve to stand in the arena.

steps.name: Iwona
steps.text: Ugh—man, I'm scrapping. Maybe I should find a chance to beat him up in private.

steps.name: A Voice on the PA
steps.text: Now—will the knights please enter the arena—

steps.name: Iwona
steps.text: Gettem.

steps.name: An Infected Knight
steps.text: Alright!

steps.name: An Infected Knight
steps.text: The kids are still waiting for us to get back.

steps.name: Brassrust Knight
steps.text: ...Gahah. Pinus Sylvestris...

steps.name: Brassrust Knight
steps.text: The Infected, a living scourge... dares to call itselves knights?

steps.name: Brassrust Knight
steps.text: To Hell with you!
